headline: ITZY's Chaeryeong postpones 3 fan signs after flu diagnosis
sub: JYP: "We'll prioritize the artist's health and recovery"
source: Source: Official statement from JYP Entertainment
caption:
ITZY's Chaeryeong has postponed three fan sign events after being diagnosed with influenza A.

JYP Entertainment said she was diagnosed on the morning of Nov 27. The events set for Nov 27, 28 and 29 move to Dec 18, 26 and 27, and winners will be notified through each platform. The agency apologized to waiting fans and said it will put her health and recovery first.

📌 Source: Official statement from JYP Entertainment
